description: It occurs where employment decisions or treatment are based on submission to or rejection of unwelcome conduct, and typically runs between people at different levels of authority. Where it results in a tangible employment action the employer has no defence to liability.
energy_note: The one category where the employer cannot argue it tried.

aspect: It is delivered as an offer, never as a threat
description: The proposition is framed as opportunity, mentorship or friendliness. Reconstructed afterwards it is unambiguous; heard at the time it is arguable, and the target's uncertainty is part of what it produces.
energy_note: Phrased so that objecting is an overreaction.

aspect: Refusal is what generates the evidence - against her
description: Nothing happens until she declines. Then the shift pattern changes, the project moves, the review is different - each individually explicable, and now she has a motive to allege.
energy_note: Nothing was done to her until she said no.

description: 'I've put us in the same hotel, it's easier for the sessions.' Then, later, lightly: 'The promotion thing - that's really my call, you know. I like to back people I get on with.' Two sentences, ten minutes apart, neither of which says anything.
energy_note: Two harmless sentences that only mean something together.

aspect: Hostile environment and quid pro quo overlap
description: EEOC guidance is explicit that hostile environment harassment can acquire quid pro quo characteristics where a supervisor abuses authority over employment decisions to make the target endure the conduct - which is how most real cases actually behave.
energy_note: The categories are cleaner in law than in a corridor.
